name: snake
_about: SCULPTED (2026-11-05, docs/engines.md 'the sculpt overlay'): a grass snake 1.5 m long, resting in a gentle S on a chain of seven segments that swing a beat apart (a wave running back down it as it goes) -- round in section, 4.3 cm thick, a slender neck and a tail that tapers over its last third; olive scales over a pale belly, dark bars down each flank; a distinct flat-topped head with plates over the eyes, round pupils, the mouth line, the yellow collar and the black one behind it, the forked tongue flicking || COATS AND VARIANTS (2026-11-06): params girth (the trunk's thickness, the neck less, the belly kept on the ground), bars and collar (the grass snake's), zig (an adder's zig-zag, flank spots, the X on its crown, the stripe behind the eye), dots (a smooth snake's paired spots, dark crown, eye stripe), saddles (a corn snake's red saddles edged black, flank blotches, a chequered belly), rings (a coral snake's red-yellow-black), blotch (a python's), slit (a vertical pupil); colours mark (the dark of a pattern), fill (its inside: a saddle's red, a python's brown), band (a coral snake's yellow), head (the head's top, else body). The patterns are PAINTS (op paint: colour only, no shape) laid along the rest pose's curve by a script, written with girth so they stay on the skin. Coats: the temperate ones the meadow picks from; variants: the exotic ones (asset manager only)
